features.name: Dynamic QR
features.description: Make every QR type dynamic. Edit destination URLs or display custom text anytime without reprinting.

features.name: Multiple Action
features.description: One QR, many destinations. Let users choose from a list of actions including URLs, Phone, and Text.

features.name: Password Protected
features.description: Secure your content. Require a password before redirecting to the URL.

features.name: Smart Routing
features.description: Intelligent redirection based on device, location, or time of scan.

features.name: Design Studio
features.description: Full branding control. Customize colors, add logos, and select frames.

features.name: Deep Analytics
features.description: Track every scan with detailed insights into user behavior and location.
